import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 升级功法指令处理器
 * 指令格式: /升级功法 {功法ID} [次数]
 * 对指定已学习功法连续升级，直到材料或灵石不足，或属性全满
 */
import { EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_SKILL_BOOK_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/batchUpgrade/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const uid = e.uid as number;

  // 解析命令参数
  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?升级功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];
  let upgradeCount = 1;
  const countStr = args.length > 1 ? args[1] : undefined;

  if (countStr === '选择' && /^\d+$/.test(skillBookIdStr ?? '') && Number(skillBookIdStr) > 0) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`选择功法【${skillBookIdStr}】的连续升级次数。`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('升级消耗经验道具与灵石；材料不足或属性全满时停止。');
    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '连续升级功法',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          ...[1, 5, 10].map(count => ({ label: `升级${count}次`, command: `/升级功法 ${skillBookIdStr} ${count}` })),
          { label: '返回功法', command: '/我的功法' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (countStr !== undefined) {
    const parsedCount = parseInt(countStr, 10);

    if (isNaN(parsedCount) || parsedCount < 1) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 升级次数必须是大于0的整数');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }
    upgradeCount = parsedCount;
  }

  if (!skillBookIdStr || skillBookIdStr === EMPTY_STRING) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('使用方法:');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/升级功法 <功法ID> [次数]');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例:');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/升级功法 123      ← 升级1次');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/升级功法 123 5    ← 升级5次');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡 次数可选，默认1');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡 当经验道具或灵石不足、或属性全满时自动停止');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const skillBookId = parseInt(skillBookIdStr, 10);

  if (isNaN(skillBookId) || skillBookId < MIN_SKILL_BOOK_INDEX) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('❌ 功法ID必须是大于0的数字');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  // 调用数据层
  const result = await App({ bid, uid, skillBookId, upgradeCount, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 您还没有已学习的功法');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'NOT_FOUND': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`❌ 找不到ID为 ${result.data.skillBookId} 的已学功法`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡 请使用 /我的功法 查看功法ID');

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'OK': {
      const {
        target,
        successCount,
        totalConsumedExp,
        totalConsumedSpiritStone,
        lastUpgradeCount,
        attributeLines,
        stopReason,
        upgradeCount: actualUpgradeCount,
        skillBookId: resultSkillBookId
      } = result.data;

      // 构建结果消息
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      if (successCount > 0) {
        md.addBold(`✅ 【${target.name}+${lastUpgradeCount}】连续升级 ${successCount} 次`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`消耗经验: ${totalConsumedExp}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`消耗灵石: ${totalConsumedSpiritStone}`);
        md.addNewline();

        if (attributeLines.length > 0) {
          md.addNewline();
          md.addText('📈 属性变化：');
          md.addNewline();

          for (const line of attributeLines) {
            md.addText(line);
            md.addNewline();
          }
        }
      } else {
        md.addBold(`❌ 【${target.name}】无法升级`);
        md.addNewline();
      }

      if (stopReason) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`停止原因：${stopReason}`);
      }

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '升级功法',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '继续升级', command: `/升级功法 ${resultSkillBookId} ${actualUpgradeCount}` },
            { label: '我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }
          ]
        })
      );
    }
  }
});

export default response;
